description:
AI-agent readiness audit of a website: score 0-100, grade and verdict across agent access (robots.txt rules for AI bots, bot challenges), readable content (raw HTML, markdown), discovery (llms.txt, sitemap, JSON-LD, meta/OG), agent interfaces (OpenAPI, MCP, A2A agent card, x402) and speed/HTTPS. Free preview tier: score, grade and category scores. The paid x402 endpoints /v1/lite ($0.005) and /v1/audit ($0.03) add the findings, prioritized fixes and ready-to-paste snippets (llms.txt draft, robots.txt lines, JSON-LD).

[AgentReady via YourAITools MCP Hub] Free tier: same as AgentReady's own MCP server (call without payment and without tier). Paid: lite $0.005 / audit $0.03 per call, with a credits key (Authorization: Bearer yatc_...) or x402 (USDC; the hub returns the payment terms). Failed tool calls aren't charged: credits are refunded automatically and x402 payments only settle on success.

tier.description: Paid tier: lite $0.005, audit $0.03. Omit tier (with no credits key or x402 payment) to use the free tier.

url.description: Website URL or domain to audit, e.g. https://example.com or stripe.com (public http/https only)

name: audit_website
title: AgentReady: AI-agent readiness audit
